# Development Build 53

Install wallaby-agent_2.0.0~dev53_amd64.deb on Ubuntu 26.04 amd64. Finish active protected work and close its workspace normally before installing.

This build fixes administrator preparation from the restricted configuration window, retaining IPv6-only networking and workspace protections. See ../AGENT_BUILD53_STARTUP_AUTHORISATION.md. Verify the installer against SHA256SUMS.txt.
